description: For each head and rank, select path-targeted floor or pooled baseline solely using training edit responses. Minimize mean selected-type immediate-output relative MSE subject to worst unselected-type training error <= pooled baseline + absolute .02. Evaluate same-type independent validation edits. Native train full-model path magnitude selects three types; no answer labels used. This is a local c_proj proxy, not a finite full-model or new-type test.
